name: GL_JE_ACTION_LOG
description:
GL_JE_ACTION_LOG stores the history of a journal batch.  Each row represents an action that has occurred on the batch, and provides the user that executed the action, the role that they were acting as, and the date and time of the action.  In the case of the reversal action, the journal that was reversed is also stored. 
This table has a many to one relationship with the GL_JE_BATCHES table, which stores the journal batches.

columns.name: JE_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Journal batch identifier. Foreign key to GL_JE_BATCHES.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the action performed on journal batch.

columns.name: ACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date and time on which the action occurred.

columns.name: JE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Journal header identifier. Foreign key to GL_JE_HEADERS.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: User definition column. Foreign key to PER_USERS.

columns.name: TARGET_JE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Target journal header identifier after journal reversal or replication actions of the source journal.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PARTITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Partition grouping information which when combined with the period, determines the database partition in which this journal will be stored.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Accounting period for the journal. Maintained in sync with the actual period for the journal. Not used to retain an audit trail of any periods the journal might previously have been associated with.

columns.name: HISTORY_HASHCODE
columns.description: Stores the hash code keys for comments, attachments, or history records. Hash code keys are 20 characters long. The application can store a maximum of 11 hash codes separated by comma. As a result, the length limit for the column is 229 characters, including commas.

columns.name: HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Unique history identifier assigned to a user comment.

columns.name: RULE_NAME
columns.description: The workflow rule used for assigning the workflow task to the user.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_NAME
columns.description: Participant in a step in the  approval workflow process.
